name: manual_b4ba73
claim: When removing personal data from a configuration, keep the control it fed: replace the value with an environment reference, document the variable, and test that the control stays present and names no literal identity.

decisions.notes: Deleting a command-owner entry to remove a number also removed the owner allow list; an automated security review caught it before any push.

rationale: Deleting a command-owner entry to remove a number also removed the owner allow list; an automated security review caught it before any push.
